title: Mosque of the Agas, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Specific Mosque of the Agas/Ağalar Camii main hall on way32396236: striped pale stone and narrow red-brick courses, tall pointed upper windows/pale grilles, round lower screened windows with pale surrounds/pointed brick relieving arches, an open front entrance with small lead hood/steps, and a shallow lead barrel roof with hipped ends/transverse bands and a representative finial. Preserve the independent low attached range and other palace members. No invented minaret/dome, copied inscriptions, historic manuscripts, plants or furnished prayer/library interior.
